entities.name: Nylea
entities.description: God on Theros who honors the worthy by transforming them into trees.

entities.name: Cactusfolk
entities.description: The only known sapient species indigenous to Thunder Junction, awoken to sapience after the plane connected to the Omenpaths in 4562 AR.

entities.name: Setessa
entities.description: Place protected by the caryatids on Theros.

events.summary: Nylea transforms those she deems worthy into trees, the caryatids, who protect Setessa.
events.quote: the god Nylea honors those that she deems worthy by transforming them into trees
